items.label: Novo Nordisk press release: Highlights to be presented at Novo's Capital Markets Day (09-21-2026)
items.signal_prefix: At its Capital Markets Day in London, Novo set strategic ambitions for 2030

set.signal: At its Capital Markets Day in London, Novo set strategic ambitions for 2030 (by 2030 from a 2026 baseline; the company states they are inherently uncertain and do not constitute its financial outlook or guidance): launch >5 multi-blockbusters by 2030 and deliver >150 bDKK risk-adjusted pipeline sales in 2035; enter or complete ≥ 5 Phase 3 programmes in obesity and diabetes and ≥ 5 in other therapy areas; deliver 2026-30 revenue CAGR in line with industry peers (Eli Lilly, AstraZeneca, Roche and others named); scale capacity to be able to serve 10x more people with obesity on oral GLP-1; serve >60m patients globally by 2030; maintain a broadly stable operating margin and an attractive dividend per share. The revenue and margin ambitions are based on adjusted metrics.

items.reason: Footnote 1 applies 'adjusted metrics' to the revenue and margin ambitions only; the entry's trailing '(adjusted metrics)' read as if it also covered the dividend per share. Also restores the footnote's 'inherently uncertain' hedge. No number changes.
items.evidence: they are inherently uncertain and do not constitute Novo's financial outlook or guidance; revenue and margin ambitions are all based on adjusted metrics
